Usage: astryx theme [options] [command]

Add, switch, build, and author themes

Options:
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  palette                        Create and work with theme-owned color palettes
  build [options] <files...>     Compile standalone themes or one keyed theme family
  list [options]                 List themes available to add
  add [options] [slug]           Add a built theme to the app. To copy a theme's source as an editable fork, run `theme eject <slug> [path] [--overwrite]`.
  remove <slug>                  Remove a non-default theme from the app
  use <slug>                     Choose the app default from its added themes
  eject [options] <slug> [path]  Fork a theme as editable local source
  template [options] [path]      Write the annotated theme template into your project
  targets [filter]               List the component theming targets a theme can override

Exit codes:
  0  help is shown or a subcommand succeeds
  1  an unknown subcommand or a subcommand failure

Examples:
  # List available and added themes
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme list
  # Import a theme into the app
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add ocean
  # Choose the default
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme use ocean
  # Fork source to customize
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme eject ocean
  # Generate a palette candidate
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme palette generate palette.config.json
  # See what a theme can override
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme targets

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/theme

Component style overrides:
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme targets            Every themeable class, with its props and states
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <Name>         One component's theming table
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs theme               How component overrides work
